verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a simulator, so the evidence supports only the simulated side of bring-up. You can start from ready-made robot models (PR2, TurtleBot, etc.) and Fuel SDF snippets, copy example worlds, write custom robot-control plugins, and install a matched Gazebo + ros_gz stack with one command, all of which plausibly speed configuration and first motion in simulation. Missing for 10: any real hardware driver bring-up, a guided new-robot configuration or bring-up workflow, evidence of first motion on a physical robot, and independent or hands-on proof that bring-up takes hours rather than weeks.
